panels.description:
Visual representation matching ASCII level bar: [---B----b----0----s----S---|]

• B = Buy Entry threshold (green) - Signal below this triggers BUY
• b = Buy Exit threshold (light green) - Exit long position
• 0 = Neutral center (gray)
• s = Sell Exit threshold (orange) - Exit short position
• S = Sell Entry threshold (red) - Signal above this triggers SELL
• Signal (cyan line) = Current position, moves between zones
panels.title: Signal Level Bar

panels.description: ADX-based market regime detection. Score > Threshold = TREND mode (follow trend), Score < Threshold = MEAN REVERSION mode (fade extremes). Regime is designed to be stable and changes infrequently.
panels.title: Regime Analysis (Score, Threshold, Fear/Greed)

panels.description: Target vs Current portfolio weight. Target W = desired exposure from strategy signal. Current W = actual exposure. Gap between them triggers rebalancing. Values near 0 = neutral, 1 = fully long, -1 = fully short.
